why_best: This subtle hierarchy adjustment keeps the viewer oriented within multi-line copy without demanding disruptive layout recalculations or screen real estate changes.
why_bad: Introducing high-contrast color pops or abrupt positional jumps would shatter the minimalist consumer app aesthetic and distract from the primary content.
trap: A flawed execution will allow character widths to expand during the focus change, causing annoying text reflows across neighboring lines.
